messages:
alex: Quick idea 12 prototype a lightweight preflight for /v1/embeddings that returns shape hints + an estimated units cost instead of rejecting immediately. goal: better UX for mixed-dim clients and actionable console signals.
anya: Is this opt-in? mixed-dim arrays and gzip framing could add ambiguity. we shouldn't add latency by default.
mike: strongly +1 on opt-in. maybe query param ?preflight=true or header X-Embed-Preflight: 1. keep it async/fastpath (<= 5ms) and only compute a cheap estimate.
kai: telemetry names: preflight.latency_ms, preflight.suggest_rate, preflight.reject_count, preflight.oversize_estimated_units. retention: 90d for dashboards, 13mo for aggregated billing histograms. also include tenant_id in sampling.
alex: design notes: preflight returns 200 with headers and a small JSON payload like: { "suggested_shape": [512], "estimated_units": 42, "note": "suggestion only - not enforced" } and headers: X-Embed-Shape: 512, X-Embed-Units: 42, X-Embed-Preflight-Version: v1
anya: for mixed dims we should return suggested_split: true and a hint for server-side split policy. example: split_policy=auto-small-first. also surface "likely-ambiguous" flag when gzip/binary framing could hide dims.
mike: implementation concerns: we already have hot code paths in ingress. add a small fast path that inspects first 1KB to detect shape heuristics. if preflight header absent -> skip. default off.
alex: rollout plan proposal: canary 1% (internal tenants), 5% (beta customers), 25% (public opt-in). console toggle per-organization + feature-flag in infra. we instrument metrics + SLI: preflight.latency_p95 < 8ms and false_suggest_rate < 2%.
kai: dashboard widgets: 1) per-tenant preflight suggest rate (sparkline) 2) oversize estimate histogram 3) preflight -> final request mismatch rate (how often someone preflight then got a different routing result). wire these into rollout gating.
opsbot: ingest-preflight-bot: canary: 5% traffic. last hour: 12 oversize estimates, p95 latency 6ms, 1 mismatch event.
mike: question about quotas: if preflight returns estimated_units, do we show that in console cost preview? we should surface but not bill until the real request lands. maybe add a 'preview estimate' in Console cost drilldown.
alex: agreed - preview only. but we'll log estimated_units for unit tests and for costing simulations. add aggregation in billing pipeline: estimated_units.daily.estimated_sum (not billed).
anya: client SDK suggestion: gracefully fallback if server suggests split: SDK can re-emit two requests with shapes from suggested_shape header. small snippet: curl -H "X-Embed-Preflight: 1" -d @payload.json /v1/embeddings?preflight=true # read X-Embed-Shape and retry if needed
mike: ops note: ensure preflight doesn't bypass rate limits. same ingress auth + quota check. also add a small rate cap so attackers can't fingerprint.
kai: telemetry detail: include preflight.sample_rate and preflight.client_hint_source (sdk/header/manual). that'll help correlate.
alex: next steps: I'll open a short RFC with API contract + minimal server spec + rollout playbook. want dev-owner for fastpath (mike?) and console tile (kai?).
mike: I can take fastpath. will prototype C++ handler + fallback.
kai: I'll draft dashboard queries and a Console PR for a "Preflight Estimates" section under Embeddings routes.
anya: will dogfood with JS SDK once feature-flag enabled. :thumbsup:
opsbot: deploybot: created canary flag ingress.preflight_v1 at 5% for team-internal.
alex: thanks - keeping this small and opt-in should avoid perf surprises. follow-up in RFC thread.
